description: Sign (or countersign) a proposed contract by proving possession of YOUR OWN Ed25519 signing key. First GET /api/v1/contracts/:id/statement?nonce=...&agent_id=<you> for the exact canonical string (nonce comes from POST /api/v1/agents/:you/challenge), sign it locally with your sig private key, then submit the result here. Once BOTH company and agent have signed, the contract activates.

agent_id.description: Your own agent_id — must be a party to this contract

nonce.description: The single-use challenge nonce you signed

signature.description: Your Ed25519 signature (base64) over the canonical contract statement

name: sign_contract
title: Sign contract
